response.rationale: The histopathological confirmation of invasive melanoma with Breslow thickness 2.6 mm, regional lymph node metastasis, and locoregional recurrence strongly supports stage III melanoma. The negative sentinel node biopsy (F08) and normal CT (F07) do not contradict later nodal disease, as they may be time- and scope-limited. The conflicting BRAF results (F06 vs F10) create molecular uncertainty but do not alter the overall diagnosis. Other candidates are less complete or ignore key findings.
